methodology.ranking_denominator: macro average over positive cases only; selected chunk labels are not exhaustive
methodology.relevance: binary exact chunk_id; unlabelled chunks count as non-relevant; recall denominator is all labelled positives
methodology.raw: service search(apply_threshold=False); domain routing still applies
methodology.gated: separate production search(apply_threshold=True), allowing candidate replenishment; keyword has no semantic gate
methodology.refusal: negative cases separate from ranking; correct means no hits AND status out_of_domain/no_evidence
methodology.latency: service elapsed_ms; one excluded positive warmup per mode; fixed case order raw then gated; no repeats; CPU
methodology.memory: bytes; process resident working set including native CPU model, vectors and allocator; before warmup/after cases; delta is not attributable allocation; peak is process lifetime, not backend peak; modes share model in one process; no GPU memory measurement
methodology.failure: any fallback, changed mode, keyword_only dense status or exception invalidates the entire mode and suppresses its averages; exit 1
